notes.title: Mac & Lunix Support!
notes.content:
As of the most recent update, Mac OS and Linux are now supported! We will be updating these as with the windows version at the same time.

Expect a large content update coming within the next couple of weeks to overhaul of the game!

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Time For Crime - RELEASE!
notes.content:
As of this post, the game is now live! Go and claim what is meant to be yours from the many vaults around idle city!

For instant support and bug reports join the discord server:
https://discord.gg/QY5SKBa

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: One Day Till Launch!
notes.content:
The game has now been fully approved by steam, and will be released at:
12pm noon (GMT) 8th June 2018.

We look forward to everyone's input on how we can further the game!

We are also working on a massive v1.1 update to come a week or so after launch to bring more suggested features with more locations, characters and so on.

Thanks for your support and we look forwards to having you enjoy the game!

For all support and info on the game join the discord server: https://discord.gg/QY5SKBa

notes.title: Beta-Testers Wanted!
notes.content:
Want early access to the game?

Join the discord for discussions and feedback: https://discord.gg/QY5SKBa

Join the Discord, then go to the #Beta-Keys section.

At this point we are mainly testing out the balance of the game, some features are not fully complete.

This is limited to the first 50 people.

Thanks for your interest!

notes.title: Ever-closer...
notes.content:
Hello! 

We have decided to push-back the game's release by a week to:
Friday the 8th of June!

This is to allow for all features to be tested and make sure that everything is fully working before release. (New features have been added since last post). Balancing is the main priority to make sure that the game is an enjoyable idle game!

In the meantime, have this picture of an almost finalised UI/Game!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32746844/a9d2a1dfbff544b0e6ab987b72fb80cdea7dfc86.png[/img]

Thanks for the huge amount of support!

notes.title: Prepare your getaway vehicle!
notes.content:
Coming soon, customise your van with skins in order to increase your earnings and chances at your getaway.

Earn enough money to buy a getaway vehicle, then proceed to send it on missions to other parts of the city where you can earn extra cash at a high-risk, high-reward rate or low-risk, low reward mission.

This will be available on launch and be one of the many vast features available in Idle Heist, hopefully launching in a couple of weeks!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32746844/2965905d8cdbb44c43aa593e179489356d55691b.gif[/img]

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Planned Release Date
notes.content:
Hello! Progress on the game is going well to help us achieve a planned release date of:

Friday June 1st, 2018 @ 12:00pm PDT

Here's a look at the city for the intro cut-scene!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32746844/ea2347455cdfa991e15c00fc1ce3106d4d75db17.png[/img]

Thanks for your continued support.

notes.title: A First Look Into Idle Heist
notes.content:
Hello! We've finally hit a milestone where we are happy to show the game in order to start generating more interest!

Check out the video for a small look for what's to come!

Please bear in mind; this is a very early build of the game and many more features are to come from it!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Aml2TZv9HDA

Feedback and thoughts are much appreciated at this point!

Thanks for your interest.

notes.title: Steam Store Appearance!
notes.content:
The game is officially on the steam store!

This is the first major step to pushing the game out, we look forwards to getting it into the hands of as many people as possible!

The game will be completely free-to-play.

For updates and sneak-peeks follow us on twitter:

https://twitter.com/ChimpLabsGames
